Premium Sudoku

A premium, highly polished Sudoku game built with Vanilla Web Technologies (HTML, CSS, JS) and natively packable as an Arch Linux Desktop Application using Electron.

## ✨ Features - **Built from Scratch**: No frameworks! Fully vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. - **Premium Aesthetics**: Features a modern dark theme, glassmorphism UI, custom Google Fonts (`Outfit`, `Space Mono`), and smooth CSS animations. - **Dynamic Board Tracker**: Highlights selected cells, related rows/columns/blocks, and shows matching numbers across the grid. - **Advanced Logic Engine**: Auto-generates fully playable Sudoku puzzles using backtracking algorithms. - **Difficulty Levels**: Select between Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert. - **Game Assistants**: Features an integrated Numpad, robust history system (Undo/Erase controls), and an intelligent Hint button. - **Desktop Ready**: Works flawlessly as a web browser game OR a native Linux desktop application via Electron (`main.js` provided). ## 🚀 Getting Started ### Play on the Web If you just want to play it in your browser: 1. Clone this repository. 2. Open `index.html` directly in your browser. 3. Enjoy! ### Play as a Desktop Application (Electron) The application has been configured to serve as a standalone, native desktop application (ideal for Arch Linux or any OS supporting Node.js). 1. Ensure you have Node.js and NPM installed. 2. Clone this repository and navigate to the root directory: ```bash cd sudoku ``` 3. Install dependencies (this fetches the required Electron binaries): ```bash npm install ``` 4. Start the game natively: ```bash npm start ``` *(or run `npx electron .`)* ## 🛠️ Arch Linux Native Integration If you are running Arch Linux and want to integrate this game into your system launcher (Application Menu), you can manually link the executable using a `.desktop` entry. Create a file at `~/.local/share/applications/sudoku.desktop`: ```ini [Desktop Entry] Name=Premium Sudoku Comment=A premium web-based Sudoku game packaged using Electron Exec=bash -c 'cd /path/to/your/sudoku/folder && npx electron .' Icon=utilities-terminal Terminal=false Type=Application Categories=Game;BoardGame;LogicGame; Keywords=sudoku;puzzle;game; StartupNotify=true ``` Run `update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications` to refresh your app menu. ## 🤝 Contribution Feel free to open an issue or submit a pull request if you want to help improve this game.
